issues.issue: Whether the claimant's written narratives (PIFs) can be relied on
issues.result_text: PIFs given no weight; claimants would not swear they were complete, true and correct.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant took all reasonable steps to seek Hungarian state protection
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he reported the 2006 attack and 2009 horse theft to police; he could not identify assailants.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not take all reasonable steps; presumption of adequate state protection not rebutted.

issues.issue: Whether Hungary's protection of Roma victims is adequate and effective
issues.applicant_position: Counsel says Hungary's laws and policies have not meaningfully protected Roma; cites justice-system shortcomings.
issues.result_text: Hungary is willing and able to protect Roma victims; inadequate protection not shown.
